subject.title: fix(doctor): skip groupAllowFrom migration for schemaless external channels

question: Should core doctor leave schemaless external channel config untouched during the groupAllowFrom fallback migration, or should external plugins get an explicit opt-in migration contract first?
rationale: The bug is real and the patch is narrow, but the permanent compatibility boundary for external plugin config repair is a maintainer-owned merge decision.

options.title: Accept Schema-Verified Core Writes
options.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers agree core doctor must not write unverified keys into external channel config.

options.title: Add External Opt-In
options.body: Pause and add a plugin doctor or schema capability if maintainers want non-bundled channels to opt into this migration safely.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Protection
options.body: Close or supersede this PR only if broader config-protection work lands the same email/RCS regression behavior and coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept Schema-Verified Core Writes
recommendation.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers agree core doctor must not write unverified keys into external channel config.

likelyOwner.reason: This account introduced and merged the fallback migration being repaired, which is the strongest routing signal for the compatibility-boundary choice.
